conditional_validation: Only if every pilot gate passes, candidate-only course/recovery at original seed2081 and original7-source validation bank, reuse paid baselines after exact initial hash matching; original teacher gates unchanged, no FlowDAgger integration.
scope: First test whether a48D state-conditioned actor can reproduce the demonstrated recovery without scripted prefix, while retaining ordinary walking. The0.70m TRAIN-case engineering ceiling is not a precision-tracking or original teacher-qualification threshold. Recovery lateral error is reported separately; supervised imitation alone is not assumed to improve on teacher drift.
selection: Final2000-update full actor only, no epoch/seed replacement. Supervised MSE to emitted targets, no critic or PPO/SAC/flow update. Original actor initialization, no time index/case id/prefix flag added to48D inputs; all actor layers train.
split: Whole environment streams env_id%4==0 are offline validation, never fitted. This is not source holdout; original7 validation sources remain untouched.
